passive.name: Ionian Fervor
passive.description: When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.

spells.name: Bladesurge
spells.description: Irelia dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and restoring Health to herself. If the enemy dies or was Unsteady, the Cooldown is refreshed. Deals damage to minions.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation ChampionDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Defiant Dance
spells.description: Begin Charging: Irelia enters a defensive stance for up to seconds, becoming unable to act but reducing physical damage taken by % and magic damage taken by %. Release: Irelia lashes out with her blades, dealing physical damage increased up to based on charge time.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MinDamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Flawless Duet
spells.description: Irelia throws a blade into the ground and can Recast for up to seconds. Recast: Irelia throws a second blade, then they fly towards each other Stunning for seconds and dealing magic damage. Champions and large jungle monsters become Unsteady for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Vanguard's Edge
spells.description: Irelia launches a barrage of blades, dealing magic damage and making champions and large jungle monsters Unsteady for seconds. The barrage explodes into a cage around the first champion hit for seconds. The cage deals magic damage and Slows by % for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MissileDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
